GATOSHM.ConfigMenuHint: Pick which header buttons stay in the title bar; all others go into the ⋮ menu.
GATOSHM.ConfigHint: Checked buttons stay in the title bar. Everything else moves into the ⋮ menu. Buttons appear in this list once a sheet that has them has been opened. Buttons other modules inject directly into the page (such as Popout's) are never moved.
GATOSHM.ConfigExtra: Extra button classes to keep (comma separated)

enabled.Name: Collapse header buttons
enabled.Hint: Move header buttons that are not in the keep list into a ⋮ menu (this client only).

scope.Name: Windows affected
scope.Hint: Which Application V1 windows get the ⋮ menu. PF1 sheets are V1 windows.

keep.Name: Buttons kept in the title bar
keep.Hint: Button CSS classes, comma separated. Use "Choose visible buttons…" for a checklist. Default: close, configure-token (Prototype Token). Buttons that modules inject straight into the page, such as Popout! and the taskbar's Tags, always stay where they are.

iconOnly.Name: Icon-only kept buttons
iconOnly.Hint: Show the kept buttons as icons with a tooltip to save even more space.

showMenuLabel.Name: Show a label on the ⋮ button

minHidden.Name: Collapse only from this many buttons
minHidden.Hint: Leave the header alone when fewer buttons than this would move into the menu.
